description: HOSTYOURHERITAGE presents a spacious and stylish apartment in the heart of Paris, ideal for families and friends: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, including a master suite with an en-suite bathroom. Bright living room with dining area & connected TV, equipped modern kitchen (Nespresso, dishwasher). Comfortable rooms with premium bedding, contemporary bathroom. Fast WiFi, linen provided, flexible check-in. Central location near Marais & Beaubourg.The spaceStay in the heart of Paris in this beautiful apartment combining space, comfort and ideal location. With 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a master suite with ensuite bathroom, it is perfect for families, friends or business travelers. • Living room: bright and refined, with a friendly seating area, dining area and smart TV. • Kitchen: modern and fully equipped (oven, stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, Nespresso machine). • Master suite: spacious bedroom with premium bedding, built-in storage and elegant private bathroom. • Second & third bedrooms: comfortable, carefully decorated, premium bedding and storage. • Second bathroom: contemporary, with modern shower and neat finishes.Fast WiFi, linen provided, flexible check-in and impeccable cleanliness complete this prestigious setting, located a stone's throw from the Marais and Beaubourg.Guest accessSpace fully available for guestsRegistration details7504838136377
